raw_text: 南海战略态势感知平台报告：印度海军歼敌者号核潜艇（INS Arihant S73）近日在孟加拉湾进行战略巡逻。我方声纳监测站在安达曼海域检测到与该艇声纹特征匹配的水下活动。SCS Probing Initiative report: Indian Navy INS Arihant (S73) SSBN detected conducting strategic deterrence patrol in Bay of Bengal. Our sonar monitoring stations in Andaman Sea detected underwater activity matching acoustic signature profile of this vessel. Patrol duration estimated at 30+ days.
clean_text: SCS Probing Initiative reports INS Arihant SSBN detected on deterrence patrol in Bay of Bengal. Chinese sonar monitoring stations in Andaman Sea detected matching acoustic signatures. Patrol estimated 30+ days. Bilingual Chinese-English report.
